title: Test case 13 — A juror's internet research (contempt of court: the estimate's limits shown as cautions)
shows: An offence at large whose sentencing the Manual leaves partly open: contempt of the County Court has no statutory maximum, and the Manual flags whether the Sentencing Act's orders apply to contempt and how its gravity and culpability are assessed, so the estimate carries those limits as cautions with their flags instead of errors. An admission at the first hearing; no prior convictions.
